notes.title: Content Update: Two New Levels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/962f99d4c9d5180651cd88ce0c0aea3567718680.png[/img]

[h1][b]What's up, partygoers![/b][/h1]

Today, we bring you a big content update featuring not one but [b]TWO[/b] new levels. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/ae6fd0b0d36c0938b4975f5cfdb65dafa070f25a.gif[/img][h2][b]🐸 New Level: Delirium Heights[/b][/h2]

Another free bonus level hits the scene! This level is rich with hidden environmental story details that reveal the deep lore of our beloved character, Frogger, and his homeland. Prepare for a trippy experience, uncovering secrets hidden within the game's most mysterious setting yet.

[i]Unlocks after completing the main story.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/3a9d29218f1078ba802e3696aadbc3c8631a6ec7.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/354cfd2960fa470581a70a12a0175fc483d50393.gif[/img][h2][b]🚀 New Level: Moon[/b][/h2]

Set foot on an unparalleled lunar adventure. Navigate through innovative traps and interact with new objects that challenge your tactical skills. [b]Moon[/b] introduces a host of novel objectives, pushing the limits of what you thought was possible in [i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i].

[i]Unlocks after completing the main story and the [b]Delirium Heights[/b] level.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]What Else's New:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New objects and traps
[/list]
[h3][b]Enhancements & Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Default brightness and post-process options fixed.
[*] A bug with Marena at the Punch Club level ending fixed.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Alpha 4 Trailer and Progress Report
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GvJ7bbJ.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, Party people! Alex here with the progress report on Party Hard 2.[/h1]

First off, I think we got it. We finally have the design of Party Hard 2. It was a long time coming—and previous alpha builds didn't really hit home with variety and emergent gameplay features you all loved from the original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/356570/Party_Hard/]Party Hard[/url]. 

Check out the trailer for Alpha 4:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7n5h5S-5AXI

[b]PAX Experiments[/b]
Fine folks from Pinokl have been traveling to PAX expos with us, tweaking builds alongside the feedback from alphas. This has been incremental in figuring out what works and what doesn't. The latest Alpha 4 build is a remake of the Vegas level from Party Hard. It is smaller, but has loads of procedural features. 

Featuring chickens, aliens, gas canisters you can fill up and light up with a trail, and much more—Alpha 4 demos the gameplay feel that's coming to the final game. 

There was this one specific player at PAXEast last month. At expos, many players like to stack bodies for some reason. They'd carefully kill off NPCs and stack their bodies behind dumpsters. So, this player stacks up a whole bunch of bodies behind the dumpsters. Then he takes a gas canister, fills it up, sprays it all over the bodies. And lights it on fire  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Oh, you can also party on a spaceship. 

For now we're doing pre-sales on http://PartyHard.game, so, if you want to check those alphas out, head on over.
